summary: Prove the complete true_residual entry per thread from fetched binary64 instructions and concrete byte memory, connect it to TorchLean tensor subtraction, and check emitted-code binding. Preserve explicit missing parallel memory admission and whole Poisson solver correspondence; this is a completed proof slice, not completion of the requested whole solver proof.

examined.reason: Added universal fetched residual correctness, execution existence, byte preservation, inactive-lane behavior and contiguous TorchLean array correspondence. No hypothesis assumes phase outputs. Parallel eight-byte admission and all other solver instruction proofs remain explicit.
Updated backend status to distinguish the new true_residual per-thread proof from still-missing parallel and whole-solver correspondence. Numerical and certified-result behavior is unchanged.

Extended the exact named dependency audit by 145 public endpoints and one separately audited executable wrapper; retained pinned dependencies, source stability checks and standard-axiom policy. Source interpretation remains separate from kernel validity.
The same reference equations, CPU Float algorithm and exact result certificate remain. The new proof is scoped to one PTX entry; no solver convergence, hardware conformance or PDE theorem is added.

results.method: integration/torchlean/check.sh; python3 hardware/check_poisson_ptx.py --run .hardware-runs/poisson-certified --output /tmp/poisson-instruction-binding-final.json; python3 -m unittest discover -s hardware -p test_*.py; stratic validate; local documentation link check; git diff --check; manual theorem/source and snapshot review
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0, manifest-pinned TorchLean/FloatLib/mathlib dependencies, Python 3, Stratic 0.1.0; locally pinned PTX ISA 9.4 document SHA-256 0aa31c15735a30b5d7c0fa1fe02570dcd37fe80800afca74bcc96c9132b81fed. No GPU execution or external model call in this change.
results.evidence: Integration build, source guard, fresh closed examples and 2730 exact dependency reports passed with only standard Lean axioms; the new executable main is separately audited. Lean/config/audit content is unchanged from the integration run snapshot. The only later changes were the frontend provenance checks, their tests and their receipt, all separately rerun. The proved 20-instruction true_residual list matches all 30 saved layouts. All 19 hardware infrastructure tests pass, including rejection of opcode/guard/layout mutations, comments/duplicate entries and missing/altered artifact hashes. All 17 receipt proof/frontend hashes match current files. New/updated guides have 20 resolving local links; Stratic links and whitespace checks pass. Final selected snapshot is stable across final checks; separate user README edits are excluded and do not affect the executed integration checks. Review confirms initial-byte operands, actual fetched instructions and addresses, no assumed phase-output equality, explicit sequential-memory restriction, and remaining eight-byte parallel admission/other kernels/host composition. This does not establish the full requested solver correspondence.
